scope: Unique high-impact runtime and repair-validation claims from the review comparison, not a re-review of all 118 reported observations. Splitting independent cases gives 26 checks from 23 groups.
interpretation: CONFIRMED in a validator packet can mean reproduced intentional behavior, not a defect. Consolidated dispositions distinguish defects, design limitations, documented prerequisites, rejected claims and unproven impact. A reproduced synthetic input is not evidence that a live producer commonly emits it.

defects.title: Production automatic repair cannot obtain a repair artifact
defects.evidence_kind: offline production-path reproduction, six base/head/master cases
defects.observed: Both accepted production depths halt with zero repair iterations and null repair pointers, even for auto-fixable drift. Mocked apply tests take a different dispatch branch.
defects.qualification: Pre-existing functional gap; PR267 advertises the new plan route without wiring production artifact creation. No unauthorized edit or false success.

defects.title: Auggie repair resume state omits its required diff baseline
defects.observed: The new final diff check requires the Phase-D baseline, but auggie's prescribed resume state and specified audit persistence do not save it. Reflect and troubleshoot do save theirs.
defects.qualification: Auggie plan route only. A wrong audit or irrecoverable data loss was not executed; safe recovery should stop and recover the original baseline rather than recapture current HEAD.

defects.title: Legacy final repair-check command omits required audit inputs
defects.evidence_kind: literal documented normalization and hard-precondition comparison
defects.observed: The prescribed legacy validate invocation becomes post mode without a diff or task log; post mode requires at least one and must stop.
defects.qualification: Pre-existing instruction usability defect. No executable slash parser or real model run was claimed; this does not demonstrate a false validation pass.

defects.title: Pending GitHub reviews invalidate completed-review discovery
defects.evidence_kind: actual historical poller executed with local gh stub and official API semantics
defects.observed: A valid PENDING review without submitted_at sets reviews_ok=false and discards the whole review page. The null-field control succeeds.
defects.qualification: Confirmed historical PR270 defect, already fixed at the checked master. No new remediation needed.

defects.title: Pagination array expansion is incompatible with pre-4.4 Bash
defects.evidence_kind: exact source plus official Bash change history; modern-shell control only
defects.observed: Both scripts expand an empty cursor array under nounset. Bash 4.4 changed that expansion from fatal to accepted; the scripts succeed on available Bash 5.2.
defects.qualification: No Bash 3.2/4.3 binary was available. Old-shell failure and macOS deployment exposure were not reproduced; applicable only if these shells are supported.

defects.title: A supported file-level finding stalls the entire review batch
defects.evidence_kind: real poller and attended gate with API-supported synthetic file-level root
defects.observed: Both line fields are legitimately null for file-level comments. Poller accepts the complete input, but classifier suppresses the batch; identical root normalizes to report-only successfully.
defects.introduced_by_reviewed_pr: snapshot-wide polling introduced; file-level reporting absent in base too
defects.qualification: No real Cosmos producer sample with file-level comments was observed. This proves supported-input handling, not frequency, and does not justify automatic edits without a line.

defects.title: Readable status prose is mistaken for a duplicate hidden marker
defects.evidence_kind: real poller and attended gate with one valid hidden envelope plus readable prose
defects.observed: Adding a readable Cosmos status heading makes a review with exactly one valid hidden marker poll; removing only the heading restores clean. Parser counts broad tokens instead of envelopes.
defects.qualification: The standard producer fixture works. Live producer use of this extra heading was not established; impact is conditional parser fragility, not a widespread outage.

defects.title: Reply-script failure diagnostics conflate permissions and other errors
defects.evidence_kind: actual scripts with local network/rate-limit/malformed-data stubs plus caller tracing
defects.observed: Several non-permission failures use the permissions-labelled exit code 3 and suppress the original error. Current refusal to write on incomplete lookup is deliberate safety behavior.
defects.qualification: Only the diagnostic/exit-contract mismatch is confirmed. Automatic caller misrouting, discarded findings and an improper permanent halt were not demonstrated.

confirmed_design_limitation.reason: Manually resolving counted roots really can leave the monitor waiting, but the positive-count lower bound is an explicit safety rule. This is a design trade-off with liveness cost, not a demonstrated implementation/spec violation.

documented_prerequisite.reason: New tier data fails against old environment slots, but deploy-environment-first is explicitly stated in PR266. No failed deployment was established; updated environment passes.

rejected.reason: A missing author means unknown identity, not known-human provenance. Refusing incomplete attribution is intentional.
Ambiguous same-second completions are explicitly rejected. Review ID is not a proven submission-order tiebreaker.
A dismissed latest review does not authorize falling back to older completion evidence.
Later unresolved roots create the scope/time ambiguity that the contract explicitly refuses.
The missing numeric database ID needed to reproduce the mismatch is rejected by the live poller before dispatch.
The low-level head override is deliberate; both real attended entrypoints reject moved-head snapshots.
Human Cosmos prose does not stall complete production snapshots; the failure requires older incomplete injected input.
The cross-worktree plan rejection is conditional on artifact creation that current production dispatch never reaches. Not a separate demonstrated failure.
One defect is not necessarily one phase. Phase bounds alone do not prove failure or unjustified plan padding.
Pre-review is explicitly advisory; headless repair policy includes separate safety checks and bounded re-audit.
Task-pointer precedence is explicit consumer behavior, not a depth-routing defect. Timeout speculation was not reproduced.

unproven.reason: Historical Cosmos mode latch is reproducible, but a marker-less latest approval being a supported Cosmos completion was not established.
Metadata is appended after advisory review, but no harmful task change, gate failure or post-start immutability breach was demonstrated.
Different spec paths do not alone prove a bad verdict: final audit also receives the generated tasklist and execution log.
Manual retry can duplicate replies, including at the base commit; no real automatic retry bypassing caller deduplication was established.
Synthetic rootless threads are rejected as designed; a legitimate GitHub response with that shape was not established.
